messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance — Sat 5 April 22:00–02:00
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The firm's DMS will be unavailable this Saturday between 22:00 and 02:00 for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please check in any open documents before 21:00. Email will be unaffected.

If you have an urgent out-of-hours need for files, contact the on-call helpdesk.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
